scope: Reconcile existing repository evidence; no external official source reauthentication performed by this run

source_clock_assumptions.decision_time: 16:00 Asia/Taipei on each Taiwan cash session
source_clock_assumptions.h10: Weekly Monday 16:15 US Eastern previous-week rates. Conservative eligible timestamp: next Thursday 16:15 ET, not the historical actual release.
source_clock_assumptions.h15: Business days 16:15 US Eastern; observation-date schedule proxy, subject to holidays and source posting checks.
source_clock_assumptions.nfci: Normally Wednesdays 08:30 US Eastern; conservative following Thursday 08:30 ET.
source_clock_assumptions.hy_ig_vix: ALFRED vintage as-of prior US calendar date but no independently verified source minute; not trading-certified.
source_clock_assumptions.historical_last_known_value: When most recent ALFRED observation is not yet scheduled release-eligible, select the most recent OLDER observed value available at the prior vintage, at most 21 calendar days old. Never backfill from future.

limitations: Only 3 independent per-series date samples validated, though every series has vintage updates over full time window.
ALFRED real-time dates are calendar dates, not source-specific intraday publication timestamps.
Source H10, Treasury and weekly series publication behavior and holidays must be independently reviewed.
Source data are not authorized for trading, TXF PnL or live risk recalibration.

official_historical_data_request.verification_rule: Require independently supplied official source file, dated record and raw SHA-256 before unlocking
